subject: Invitation to Annual Company Gala
body: Dear team members, You are cordially invited to attend our annual company gala event on Saturday, December 15th. Join us for an evening of celebration, recognition, and fun as we look back on the achievements of the year. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom of the Plaza Hotel, starting at 7:00 PM. Please RSVP by December 5th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name] Events Team
